# forward_aws_organization_accounts (Data Source)

Discover AWS Organizations accounts using the AWS SDK credential chain and build Forward assume-role account entries.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MPL-2.0

variable "forward_collection_role_name" {
  description = "Stable IAM role name deployed to each AWS account."
  type        = string
}

variable "aws_profile" {
  description = "Optional AWS profile with organizations:DescribeOrganization, organizations:ListAccounts, and organizations:ListParents."
  type        = string
  default     = null
}

data "forward_aws_assume_role_external_id" "current" {}

data "forward_aws_organization_accounts" "current" {
  role_name   = var.forward_collection_role_name
  external_id = data.forward_aws_assume_role_external_id.current.external_id
  aws_profile = var.aws_profile
}

output "forward_assume_role_infos" {
  value = data.forward_aws_organization_accounts.current.assume_role_infos
}

output "manual_account_data_json" {
  value = data.forward_aws_organization_accounts.current.manual_account_data_json
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `role_name` (String) Stable IAM role name that exists in every AWS account Forward should collect.

### Optional

- `aws_profile` (String) Optional shared AWS config profile for Organizations discovery. When omitted, the AWS SDK default credential chain is used.
- `aws_region` (String) AWS region used to configure the Organizations client. Defaults to us-east-1 when omitted.
- `exclude_account_ids` (List of String) Optional deny-list of AWS account IDs to exclude.
- `external_id` (String) External ID to include in every assume-role entry. Use the forward_aws_assume_role_external_id data source when Forward should generate it.
- `include_account_ids` (List of String) Optional allow-list of AWS account IDs to include.
- `include_suspended` (Boolean) Include non-ACTIVE AWS accounts. Defaults to false.

### Read-Only

- `account_count` (Number) Number of accounts emitted after filters.
- `accounts` (Attributes List) AWS Organizations accounts emitted after filters. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--accounts))
- `assume_role_infos` (Attributes List) Forward AWS assume-role entries derived from the discovered AWS accounts and role_name. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--assume_role_infos))
- `feature_set` (String) AWS Organizations feature set.
- `management_account_id` (String) AWS Organizations management account ID.
- `manual_account_data_json` (String) JSON array compatible with Forward's manual AWS account upload flow.
- `organization_arn` (String) AWS Organizations organization ARN.
- `organization_id` (String) AWS Organizations organization ID.
- `skipped_account_count` (Number) Number of accounts skipped because of state or include/exclude filters.

Read-Only:

- `email` (String)
- `id` (String)

- `parent_ids` (List of String)
- `state` (String)


<a id="nestedatt--assume_role_infos"></a>
### Nested Schema for `assume_role_infos`

Read-Only:

- `account_id` (String) AWS account ID.
- `account_name` (String) AWS account name.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether Forward collection is enabled for this account.
- `error_msg` (String) Forward collection error message, when returned by the API.
- `external_id` (String) External ID supplied to STS AssumeRole.
- `role_arn` (String) IAM role ARN Forward should assume for this account.
